outages.headline: Greater fuel oil sales raise Antwerp-Bruges bunker volumes
outages.summary: Antwerp-Bruges’ bunker sales totalled 2 million mt in the second quarter, up 3% from a year earlier, port data shows. Bunker sales were down by 2% between the first and second quarters. Antwerp-Bruges surpassed Rotterdam in the first quarter to become the world’s second-largest bunker port. outages.headline: Ukraine’s Drone War Is Choking Kazakhstan’s Oil Exports
outages.summary: Kazakhstan should, in theory, be one of the major beneficiaries of Russia’s growing isolation from global energy markets. Its crude is unsanctioned and European refiners need alternatives to Russian barrels. Yet instead of gaining a clear geopolitical advantage, Kazakhstan has found itself exposed to many of the same risks as its northern neighbour: attacks on export infrastructure, disruptions inside Russia and repeated operational failures at its own largest fields.
